text:
Maya (Partnerships): Quick update — Tessera Health signed a 3-year renewal for Dedicated capacity and has opted into a Private deployment for their regulated workloads. They also agreed to do a joint case study + performance writeup. :tada:

Noah (Account Executive): Huge — this was a long one. 3yr commitment with a modest ramp in year 1, guaranteed throughput targets, and a data residency SLA. They specifically called out latency improvements from the runtime changes.

Sarah (Product): Amazing. Can we get a quick list of the measurable outcomes they'd be willing to share? e.g., p50/p95 improvements, token cost reduction percentages, failover behavior?

Noah (Account Executive): They signed off on sharing p50 (40% lower), p95 (30% lower), and a monthly cost-per-1M-token comparison after Optimize tuning. They asked to redact raw customer volume numbers though.

Arjun (Eng): Nice. We should capture the config that drove the wins: batching policies we applied, KV cache TTLs, and the quantization profile. I'll draft a short tech appendix.

Maya (Partnerships): Proposal for the case study headline (draft):

```
"Tessera Health reduces inference latency by 40% and cuts per-token cost after Redwood Optimize tuning — 3-year Dedicated + Private commitment"
```

Marcos (Marketing): Love that. I'll prep a customer quote request and a short landing hero. @Noah please drop the approved quote in the shared doc: https://redwood.internal/case-studies/tessera-draft (internal).

Noah (Account Executive): On it. Planning to gather an exec quote from Tessera's CTO and a usage blurb from their ML lead. ETA: EOD Friday.

Arjun (Eng): For the appendix, snippet of the runtime tweaks we used (will paste in the doc):

```
- batching: target_batch_ms=20, max_batch=64
- kv_cache: ttl=3600s, prefix_caching=true
- quant_profile: int8-ggml tuned for A100
```

Sarah (Product): Can marketing call out Redwood Optimize as the lever for cost reductions? Want to tie this to our product messaging — "Optimize-driven cost reductions" with a small explainer card.

Maya (Partnerships): Tessera is OK with naming Redwood Optimize. They liked the recommendations engine.

Emma (CEO): Huge win — congratulations team. Please queue this for the weekly all-hands highlight and loop in Legal for sign-off on the case study copy. @Marcos can you get a read from Legal? :rocket:

Marcos (Marketing): Will do. I'll ping Legal and Security for any redlines, then circle back here with the final outline.

OpsBot: case-study-draft created by Marcos at https://redwood.internal/case-studies/tessera-draft (access: partners-case-studies)

Noah (Account Executive): Also — Tessera requested a short joint webinar in Q2. We should track that in the partnerships tracker and coordinate with Customer Success for a migration/rollout session.

Maya (Partnerships): Adding webinar + CS session to the tracker. Congrats again everyone, big impact for our healthcare vertical strategy. :raised_hands:
